frontmatter.name: ponytail-audit
frontmatter.description: Audit an entire repository for avoidable complexity, unnecessary dependencies, speculative abstractions, wrappers, dead flexibility, and custom code replaceable by existing, standard-library, or native capabilities. Use for an explicit repository-wide Ponytail, bloat, deletion, or over-engineering audit; report findings without applying fixes.

frontmatter.name: ponytail-debt
frontmatter.description: Find and report deliberate `ponytail:` shortcut comments across a repository, including each shortcut's stated ceiling and upgrade trigger. Use when the user asks what Ponytail deferred, requests a shortcut or debt ledger, or wants to find simplifications that may need revisiting. Read and report only unless persistence is explicitly requested.

frontmatter.name: ponytail-gain
frontmatter.description: Present Ponytail's published agentic benchmark results with their scope and limitations. Use when the user asks what Ponytail measured, requests its impact scoreboard, or wants its reported code, token, cost, speed, or safety results. Never represent upstream benchmark figures as measurements of the current repository.

frontmatter.name: ponytail-help
frontmatter.description: Explain the bundled Ponytail skills and lite, full, and ultra levels. Use when the user asks how Ponytail works, which skill to use, or how to change its intensity.

frontmatter.name: ponytail-review
frontmatter.description: Review a fixed diff or change set only for avoidable complexity, redundant dependencies, speculative abstractions, and code that can be deleted or replaced by existing, standard-library, or native capabilities. Use for an explicit Ponytail or over-engineering review; this complements rather than replaces correctness-focused code review.

frontmatter.name: prompt-enhancer
frontmatter.description: Automatically use before acting on a new task or a material change in scope to turn the user's request into an evidence-grounded execution brief. Pair with clarify-before-building for missing context; also use for explicit prompt creation, rewriting, or critique. Clear, small requests need only an internal check; status questions and casual conversation do not need enhancement.

frontmatter.name: clarify-before-building
frontmatter.description: Automatically use before non-trivial, unfamiliar, or ambiguous work to resolve material gaps from evidence and user answers. Own the clarification pass shared with prompt-enhancer, then hand confirmed context back for execution without inventing requirements or repeating questions.

frontmatter.name: security-checklist
frontmatter.description: Immediately use when a user supplies actual or suspected raw credentials, API keys, secrets, passwords, tokens, session cookies, or private keys; pause execution and guide safe recovery. Also use before finishing changes involving authentication, authorization, payments, user data, file uploads, or external services.
